suggested_actions: Prepare beta-blocker per protocol, pending physician order
rollback_steps: Discontinue continuous ECG monitoring once vitals stabilize
Cancel pending medication order if not administered
risk_factors: Elevated heart rate can be caused by patient anxiety or movement artifact, not a cardiac event
Beta-blocker administration without physician confirmation carries dosing risk
Continuous ECG monitoring can trigger alarm fatigue if started on a transient spike

rollback_steps: Cannot be rolled back automatically — requires physician sign-off
risk_factors: Pulse oximeter readings are unreliable on patients with poor peripheral circulation or nail polish
Paging rapid response for a false reading has a real cost to other patients being triaged
Supplemental oxygen at high flow can mask a worsening underlying condition if over-relied on

rollback_steps: Return IV fluid rate to baseline once BP normalizes
risk_factors: Low blood pressure readings can result from incorrect cuff sizing or arm position
Increased IV fluid rate is risky for patients with underlying heart or kidney conditions
